packageRules.description: Pins with in-catalog constraints: bump only via a deliberate manual change.
The validation API shares its catalog version with the screenshot Gradle plugin but is often published first; only the plugin moves that version, or the build asks for a plugin that does not exist.
From v6 the caching in gradle/actions is a proprietary component under Gradle's terms of use; stay on v5 (MIT).
The vault-vectors CI job tests scripts/cuevault.py on Python 3.9, the oldest it supports: the image takes digest updates only, never another Python.
Renovate cannot tell which release still supports Python 3.9, so cryptography stays on its current major until someone checks Requires-Python; see CONTRIBUTING.
Renovate cannot tell which release still supports Python 3.9, so typing-extensions stays on its current minor until someone checks Requires-Python; see CONTRIBUTING.
scripts/cuevault.py has to run on the system Python of macOS, 3.9, which cffi 2.1 dropped; see CONTRIBUTING.
scripts/cuevault.py has to run on the system Python of macOS, 3.9, which pycparser 3 dropped; see CONTRIBUTING.
The JDK moves only together with the daemon JVM, compileOptions and detekt (which cannot run on 25+), see CONTRIBUTING.
